## Disassembly steps

1. Download apk file like [talkingtomcamp](../../data/com.outfit7.talkingtomcamp_1.6.6.381-23_minAPI16(armeabi-v7a)(nodpi)_apkmirror.com.apk)
2. Make a new directory to unpack the apk into (many files directly in root of unpacked data) and cd into this directory
3. Unzip apk `unzip <myapk>.apk

```shell
cd ~/src/my-software-dev/data
mkdir talkingtomcamp
cd talkingtomcamp
unzip ../com.outfit7.talkingtomcamp_1.6.6.381-23_minAPI16\(armeabi-v7a\)\(nodpi\)_apkmirror.com.apk
```
